hero.headline: Frontend Engineer building scalable and automated systems.
hero.description: I build modern, scalable, and high-performance interfaces. I combine advanced frontend with automation and AI to create solutions that drive real impact.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a Frontend Engineer with experience building complex web applications in production. My approach goes beyond code: I design scalable architectures, optimize user experiences, and automate processes to maximize impact.
about.p2: I have solid experience with React, Astro, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems. I've led the frontend development of platforms handling thousands of users, always prioritizing performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
about.p3: What sets me apart is my hybrid capability: I combine high-level frontend development with automation (n8n, RPA, Power Automate) and AI integration. This allows me to build complete solutions that solve real business problems.
about.highlight3_desc: n8n, RPA, Power Automate, AI integration

project1.title: E-commerce Platform
project1.description: High-performance online store with a headless architecture designed to handle major traffic spikes.
project1.problem: Operations needed to scale during campaigns and peak seasons without checkout failures or slowdowns.
project1.solution: Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma, plus layered caching, smart prefetching, and optimized critical queries.
project1.results: Stable checkout under high peaks · Fast navigation · Solid foundation for growth

project2.title: Context Generator for Journalists
project2.description: Media crawler that builds editorial context for writers with an investigative workflow.
project2.problem: Writers were losing time searching for background and connections between actors, events, and publications.
project2.solution: Crawling and semantic enrichment pipeline that generates relationship graphs, timelines, related content, and SEO suggestions.
project2.results: Faster research · Better context per article · Assisted editorial workflow
project2.tech: Node.js, NLP, Graph DB, SEO tooling

project3.title: Astro + WordPress Headless
project3.description: WordPress portal modernization keeping wp-admin while moving the frontend to a faster experience.
project3.problem: The existing portal was slow, and the editorial team needed to keep their usual WordPress publishing flow.
project3.solution: Headless architecture: content served from WordPress and frontend rebuilt with Astro, prioritizing performance and operational continuity.
project3.results: Improved load time · Same editorial workflow · Better UX
project3.tech: Astro, WordPress Headless, REST API, JavaScript

project4.title: Pigasus
project4.description: Restaurant e-commerce in Medellin with an end-to-end operation from payment to kitchen execution.
project4.problem: The business needed full digital order flow: payment, internal processing, and user tracking.
project4.solution: WordPress commerce setup with payment gateway integration, direct kitchen order routing, and order status tracker.
project4.results: Centralized orders · Less operational friction · Better customer visibility

project5.title: Enterprise RPA System
project5.description: Automation for reporting and data management processes that previously required extensive manual work.
project5.problem: The finance team spent 8 hours daily building Excel reports with high risk of human error.
project5.solution: RPA bot with Power Automate and Rocketbot that extracts, processes, validates, and generates reports automatically.
project5.tech: Power Automate, Rocketbot, Excel API, SQL Server, Python

project6.title: Internal Projects
project6.description: Collection of projects where I started: mostly WordPress, plus implementations in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
project6.problem: Need to build functional solutions with limited resources while strengthening core technical foundations through real projects.
project6.solution: Continuous delivery of sites and digital specials with a practical mindset, improving web structure and implementation quality over time.
project6.results: Strong technical foundation · Visible professional growth · High learning volume

automation.title: Automation & AI
automation.description: Automation isn't just a tool, it's a mindset. I apply systems thinking to identify repetitive processes and create solutions that scale.
automation.n8n_desc: I design and implement complex automation workflows that connect multiple services and APIs. From data processing to smart notifications.
automation.rpa_desc: Experience with Rocketbot and Power Automate for automating enterprise processes involving legacy systems, Excel, and internal platforms.
automation.ai_desc: I use AI models to power automations: document classification, content generation, data analysis, and vibe coding to accelerate development.
automation.impact1: 500+ hours saved monthly on automated processes
automation.impact2: Integration of 20+ different services and APIs

role1.title: Grupo El Colombiano / Full-Stack Developer

My role includes writing clean, scalable code and implementing technical solutions focused on performance and user experience. During this period, I gained strong experience with content management systems, especially WordPress, both in traditional mode and headless architecture. This allowed me to integrate CMS workflows with modern technologies, improving content delivery and making administration easier for non-technical users.

Scalable code implementation focused on performance and UX
Integration of traditional and headless WordPress with modern frontend
Content delivery optimization for editorial teams
